payload.title: Document embedding a cyclotron in an application, with Papyrus as the worked example
payload.description:
Add a README section and a docs page: the four SDK calls, the store and lease, the review-rate program, the two widgets, and the status shape, using the Papyrus relevance cyclotron as the example (see project/wiki/papyrus-integration.md). Use the glossary vocabulary (item, cyclotron, classifier, decision model, ML model, LLM optimizer, decision, confidence, reviewer, review, label, correction, explanation, feedback, cycle, version). Ordering: last.

Acceptance criteria:
- The quickstart runs offline with a scripted decision model and is covered by the existing README snippet check.
- The page states what the application owns (items, reviewers, its system of record) and what the engine owns (labels, partitions, propensities, versions).
- No retired glossary words appear in the new text.,
